title: The Carpet
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office staff deals with a mysterious smell and a pile on Michael’s carpet, leading to suspicions of damage and hate crime accusations. Meanwhile, relationships and personal ambitions unfold, including Kelly’s admiration for a coworker and Michael’s reflections on office camaraderie and fears of becoming like Ed Truck.
